hints.title: Two-Phase Pointer Stepping
hints.text: Step forward m - 1 times to position current pointer at the last node of the retained segment.

hints.title: Skipping Target Interval
hints.text: Advance a temporary pointer n + 1 times starting from current to locate the reconnect node.

hints.title: Pointer Re-linking
hints.text: Set curr.next to the reconnect node, then update curr to continue the cycle.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: L: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Every node in the linked list is traversed at most once during stepping and skipping.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Allocating new linked list structures uses redundant O(L) memory when in-place pointer relinking suffices.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Modifying next pointers in-place guarantees strictly constant extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean in-place pointer traversal with guard clauses against null termination.
